title: Volcanoes of Africa (guided)
intro: 10 volcanoes of Africa, one after another. Put your marker as near as you can; the nearer, the more points. The map shows coasts, rivers, lakes and borders to help you.

rounds.name: Mallahle
rounds.fact: Mallahle is a volcano with a recorded summit elevation of 1,875 m in the source data. The data places it in Ethiopia.

rounds.name: Mount Marsabit
rounds.fact: Mount Marsabit is a volcano with a recorded summit elevation of 1,707 m in the source data. The data places it in Kenya.

rounds.name: Tepi

rounds.name: Nyiragongo
rounds.fact: Nyiragongo is a stratovolcano; the latest significant eruption recorded for it in the source data was in 2021. The data places it in Democratic Republic of the Congo.

rounds.name: Tin Zaouatene volcanic field
